title: Pattern recognition
coverage_limit: Receptor expression is not proof of pathway activation. Viral and sterile injury can share sensors while requiring different interpretations.

title: Complement
coverage_limit: Mechanistic involvement does not establish benefit from complement inhibition in every cardiac disease.

title: Inflammasome
coverage_limit: Distinguish evidence about a specific inflammasome from evidence about its downstream cytokines.

title: Cytokine networks
coverage_limit: A fall in CRP or another biomarker does not establish a reduction in cardiovascular events.

title: Immunometabolism
coverage_limit: A promising translational field; changing a cellular metabolic pathway is not automatically a validated therapy.

title: Gut–heart axis
coverage_limit: A prospective association or a predictive model does not show that changing the microbiome prevents cardiovascular disease.

title: Cardiac macrophages
coverage_limit: Much mechanistic evidence comes from models; origin alone does not fully define a cell’s function.

title: T lymphocytes
coverage_limit: Cell identity, activation state and tissue context matter; “lymphocyte” is not one uniform mechanism.

title: Dendritic cells
coverage_limit: Conventional and plasmacytoid subsets have different functions. Benefits of engineered cells in experimental models do not establish a clinical treatment.

title: Neutrophils & NETs
coverage_limit: Circulating NET-associated markers do not uniquely identify tissue NET formation or show that NET-directed treatment improves clinical outcomes.

title: Antigen presentation
coverage_limit: Distinguish antigen presentation, demonstrable antigen-specific responses and proof that those responses cause disease.

title: Immune tolerance
coverage_limit: Tolerance is not simply the absence of inflammation or general immunosuppression.

title: Resolution
coverage_limit: Stopping inflammation and restoring functional tissue are related but different outcomes.

title: Remodeling
coverage_limit: Remodelling describes a process; it is not synonymous with inflammation or proof of its cause.

title: Fibrosis
coverage_limit: Active fibroblast signalling, accumulated scar and potential reversibility are different quantities. An imaging signal needs validation against the biological process it is claimed to measure.

title: Regeneration
coverage_limit: Results in mice do not establish restoration of human myocardium or a ready-to-use treatment.

title: Atherosclerosis
coverage_limit: Inflammation is one component of risk, alongside other established contributors.

title: Pericarditis
coverage_limit: Clinical assessment and disease-specific guidance are needed; a pathway alone does not define management.

title: Myocarditis
coverage_limit: The cause, clinical presentation and evidence of tissue injury need individual assessment.

title: Sarcoidosis
coverage_limit: A diagnosis in one organ does not by itself define the presence or severity of cardiac involvement.

title: Amyloidosis
coverage_limit: AL and transthyretin amyloidosis are distinct; infiltration must not be equated with active immune inflammation.

title: Systemic diseases
coverage_limit: Mechanisms and organ patterns differ between diseases; extrapolation requires care.

title: Vasculitis
coverage_limit: The vasculitis subtype matters; a general label does not determine a patient’s organ involvement.

title: Autoinflammation
coverage_limit: Autoinflammation and autoimmunity overlap in some settings but are not interchangeable terms.

title: Pulmonary hypertension
coverage_limit: The underlying group and cause matter; inflammation is not the sole explanation for pulmonary hypertension.

title: Heart failure & cardiomyopathy
coverage_limit: Heart failure is not one immune disease; identifying a mechanism requires more than the syndrome label.

title: Cardio-oncology
coverage_limit: Risk and management depend on the treatment and clinical setting; mechanisms cannot be generalised across agents.

title: Cardio-infectiology
coverage_limit: The selected influenza study combines human observations with mechanistic animal work. It does not explain every infection-related cardiac syndrome.

title: Transplantation
coverage_limit: Rejection, infection and graft dysfunction are distinct problems requiring specialist evaluation.

title: Ocular immunity
coverage_limit: An inflammatory sign in the eye does not establish a cardiac diagnosis.

title: Renal immunity
coverage_limit: The selected human study identifies signatures in lupus nephritis. Its findings cannot diagnose cardiac involvement or establish a cardiac therapeutic target.

title: Neuroimmune axis
coverage_limit: This conceptual connection does not imply a common cardiac mechanism or treatment.

title: Pulmonary immunity
coverage_limit: Shared inflammatory vocabulary does not mean identical organ behaviour.

title: Cardio-rheumatology
coverage_limit: Troponin indicates myocardial injury in context; assay interference and non-inflammatory causes must also be considered.

title: Clonal haematopoiesis
coverage_limit: Risk associations and mechanistic models do not establish routine population screening or a validated clone-directed cardiovascular treatment.

title: Chemokines & trafficking
coverage_limit: Chemokine abundance alone cannot identify its cellular source, demonstrate a functional gradient or establish benefit from receptor blockade.

title: Autoantibodies
coverage_limit: Association, functional activity and pathogenic causality are different claims. A positive antibody test does not by itself justify immune therapy.

title: Trained immunity
coverage_limit: This is not antigen-specific adaptive memory. Demonstrating a chromatin signature alone does not establish a clinically useful intervention.

title: B cells & plasma cells
coverage_limit: B-cell depletion and suppression of long-lived plasma cells are not equivalent. Findings in experimental myocarditis do not establish a broadly effective cardiac treatment.

title: NK cells & ILCs
coverage_limit: NK, NKT and ILC subsets should not be conflated. A circulating cell count cannot establish the function of a tissue-resident population.

title: Eosinophils
coverage_limit: A normal blood count does not exclude tissue disease. Imaging can suggest a phenotype but cannot by itself establish its histological cause.

title: Mast cells
coverage_limit: Many functional claims remain preclinical. Cell abundance, degranulation and the effect of a particular mediator require different measurements.

title: Platelets
coverage_limit: Platelet activation is not one uniform state. A circulating activation marker does not demonstrate a causal tissue interaction.

title: Endothelium
coverage_limit: An endothelial transcriptomic signature needs functional validation. The heart and lung do not share one uniform endothelial programme.

title: Cardiomyocytes
coverage_limit: A pathogen signal or an inflammatory transcript is not enough to separate direct cytotoxicity from immune-mediated damage.

title: Fibroblast niches
coverage_limit: A fibroblast marker or a predicted ligand–receptor pair does not establish a functional interaction. Reducing scar formation and restoring contractile tissue are different outcomes.

title: Cardiac lymphatics
coverage_limit: More lymphatic vessels do not automatically mean effective drainage. Translational benefit needs demonstration beyond vessel density in animal tissue.

title: Efferocytosis
coverage_limit: Increased phagocyte numbers do not establish efficient clearance. A mechanistic rescue in a model does not establish clinical efficacy.

title: Cell death & danger
coverage_limit: A single marker rarely identifies a unique death programme. PANoptosis describes proposed coordinated death circuitry and requires mechanistic evidence.

title: Immune ageing
coverage_limit: A senescence-associated marker is not a complete cell identity. Senolytic findings in models do not establish routine human cardiac treatment.

title: Systemic hypertension
coverage_limit: Most hypertension is not established as an autoimmune disease. Immune associations do not replace validated blood-pressure management or establish benefit from immunosuppression.

title: Rhythm & conduction
coverage_limit: An inflammatory association does not prove an immune cause of an arrhythmia. Results in atrial fibrillation cannot be assumed to apply to every rhythm disorder.

title: Valvular disease
coverage_limit: Not every valve lesion is immune-mediated. A review of rheumatic disease does not establish the mechanism of degenerative calcific disease.

title: Aorta & large vessels
coverage_limit: A growth-rate association in an observational cohort does not prove treatment efficacy. Genetic and degenerative aneurysms must not be relabelled as autoimmune disease.

title: Immunothrombosis & APS
coverage_limit: An isolated antiphospholipid antibody result does not establish antiphospholipid syndrome. Classification criteria and individual clinical diagnosis serve different purposes.

title: Cardiac imaging
coverage_limit: An imaging pattern cannot automatically identify an immune cause. Molecular tracers require validation against the biological process they are claimed to measure.

title: Biomarkers & sampling
coverage_limit: A biomarker may reflect processes outside the heart. A statistical association does not establish clinical utility or a treatment threshold.

title: Single-cell & spatial
coverage_limit: Dissociation, sampling and computational choices can alter the result. Proximity and inferred ligand–receptor pairing do not establish causality; developmental and adult tissues are distinct.

title: Causal evidence
coverage_limit: A positive trial supports its tested intervention and setting, not every anti-inflammatory strategy. Bias, transportability, adverse events and absolute effects remain part of interpretation.

title: Therapeutic translation
coverage_limit: A neutral trial is not proof that immunity is irrelevant, and a positive trial does not validate all immune inhibition. Infection, toxicity and treatment interactions require separate assessment.
